risk_note: RV1 paths (catalog/favorites) with rule tests (test/spec, RV2 by PR): favorites use cases for 04 §3.2 / §6.3 and BR-ID-30 ⑱ (05 B1-28 second part), Codex implementation under ops/approvals.yaml id 30. Idempotent add (existing row returned, 23505 mapped back to it) with the per-user cap favorites.max_per_user (default 200; 20001 favorites_full) checked inside one transaction under a per-user advisory lock; remove and batch delete (≤ 100, own rows only); opaque cursor pages by created_at, id descending (20 per page) with a card port on the catalog card entry (retrieval, link registration and quote snapshot only, no conversion; unavailable or failing items invalid with title and image only); isFavorited; delete all of a user (deletion wiring separate). No route yet (B1-28c). Implementation attempt 1 voided by the wrapper's position check (the orchestrator created a branch during the run); attempt 2 is the one committed. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
